title: Dispatch middleware order — privacy wrapper coverage
scope: Actual middleware exercised against a stub /redact server on loopback. No OPF model, real adapter, persistence or network egress.

defects_closed.P1_mutation_coverage: isMutationMethod() replaces the six-name WRITE_OPS set: an exact-name set plus a camelCase <verb><Noun> prefix rule, with read verbs listed so they can never be captured. createEpic, storeSnapshot, publishDigest, updateBead and removeEpic are mutations; get/list/query/search/fetch/read/resolve/health are not, and `created`/`adder` are not (the boundary is required).
defects_closed.P2_field_coverage: Every string leaf reachable in the arguments is assigned a role. content (value/text/title/metadata/labels/... and anything nested inside them) is REDACTED in place; identifier (key/id/uri/urn/namespace/...) is SCREENED and never rewritten, because rewriting a key would silently change what the record is addressed by; every other string is unclassified and screened the same way, so a new field cannot quietly become an exfiltration path. Personal data found in a screened field rejects the write under strict and is counted under soft (opf_identifier_pii_total).
defects_closed.P3_type_preservation: A redacted leaf is written back through a copy-on-write setter that preserves array-ness and prototypes. An object value stays an object of the same shape, an array stays an array, a string stays a string, and the caller’s own object is not mutated.
defects_closed.P4_policy_and_failure: strict rejects and soft fails open with the ORIGINAL payload for: unreachable sidecar, HTTP 500, non-JSON body, a response with no text field, and a response whose field delimiter did not survive (typed RedactionShapeError, counted by opf_redaction_shape_errors_total). A cyclic or over-deep payload cannot be certified redacted and is rejected under strict. off and OPF_MODE=off make no call at all.

one_round_trip: All fields travel in a single /redact call joined by a per-call 16-byte random delimiter; the response must split back into exactly the same number of segments or nothing is applied. The existing contract test’s "exactly one OPF call" assertion still holds.
traversal_vs_redaction: A test asserts explicitly that the L08 traversal marker is present on an off-policy payload whose content was NOT redacted — the marker is a traversal fact, never evidence of verified redaction.
